prompts.description:
Start a split migration harness session for a project.

    framework: e.g. 'Spring Boot', 'WildFly', 'Quarkus'
    current_version: the version the project is migrating FROM, e.g. '2.7'
    target_version: the version the project is migrating TO, e.g. '3.2'
    project_id: unique project identifier (used in plan.md header)
    stage: one of research, plan, gap-check, clarify, preview, execute (default: plan)
prompts.name: start_migration

prompts.description:
Resume a file-state migration from an existing ps-migration/ folder.

    migration_folder: path to ps-migration/{framework}-{from}-to-{to}/ in the consumer repo.
    stage: one of research, plan, gap-check, clarify, preview, execute (default: execute).
prompts.name: resume_migration

prompts.description:
Zero-parameter fallback for clients that do not support parameterized prompts.

    Prefer start_migration or resume_migration when the client supports parameters.
prompts.name: migration_workflow_prompt

tools.description:
Install migration skill bundles for the active server mode to a local skills directory.

    target: 'auto', 'cursor', or 'claude-code' — used to suggest the install directory.
            'auto' defaults to 'cursor'.
    target_dir: override the install root directory (skills parent for all bundles).
    project_dir: starting directory for project-root detection; defaults to the process CWD.
    scope: 'project' (default) installs under {project_root}/.cursor/skills or
           {project_root}/.claude/skills; 'global' installs under ~/.cursor/skills or
           ~/.claude/skills. Ignored when target_dir is set.

    Returns:
      status, target, installed_paths, message, mode, installed_skills, project_root, scope

project_dir.description: Optional starting directory for project-root detection; defaults to the process CWD.
project_dir.title: Project Dir

scope.description: 'project' installs under the project skills directory; 'global' installs under the user skills directory.
scope.title: Scope

target_dir.description: Optional explicit skills parent directory; overrides target and scope path resolution.
target_dir.title: Target Dir

tools.name: install_migration_skill

tools.description:
Resolve a com.paysafe.* dependency via FindIt and GitLab. Returns repo, tags, and migration guidance.

    Requires FINDIT_AUTH_TOKEN and GITLAB_API_KEY environment variables. Returns a RESOLUTION_FAILED dict with subStatus='auth_error' if FINDIT_AUTH_TOKEN is absent.
    Pass target_version to filter returned tags to those compatible with that framework version.
    Scans at most max_tags (default 15) within a 45s wall-clock budget. For BOM-only repos without
    per-tag framework metadata, omit target_version or set allow_latest_overall=True.
    The tool delegates entirely to the Paysafe resolver — check resolver logs for root-cause errors.

allow_latest_overall.description: Allow selecting the latest tag even when per-tag framework compatibility metadata is unavailable.
allow_latest_overall.title: Allow Latest Overall

framework.description: Optional framework identifier for compatibility filtering, for example 'spring-boot'.
framework.title: Framework

max_tags.description: Maximum number of repository tags to inspect within the resolver wall-clock budget.
max_tags.title: Max Tags

pinned_tag.description: Optional exact Git tag to inspect instead of selecting from recent tags.
pinned_tag.title: Pinned Tag

pinned_version.description: Optional exact dependency version to prefer when present in repository metadata.
pinned_version.title: Pinned Version

service_name.description: FindIt service name for the com.paysafe dependency, for example 'payments-core'.
service_name.title: Service Name

target_version.description: Optional target framework version used to filter compatible tags when metadata is available.
target_version.title: Target Version

tools.name: resolve_paysafe_dependency_by_service_name

tools.description:
Search migration rules and community insights using hybrid BM25 + vector ranking (RRF).

    Returns up to max_results hits ordered by Reciprocal Rank Fusion score. Each hit
    includes: statement, action_step, source_url, node_type, score.
    Vector search requires embeddings; if embeddings were not generated (POPULATE_MIGRATION_EMBEDDINGS=false),
    only BM25 results are returned.

framework.description: Framework filter for hydrated graph results, for example 'Spring Boot'.
framework.title: Framework

max_results.description: Maximum number of fused BM25/vector hits to return.
max_results.title: Max Results

min_vector_similarity.description: Minimum vector similarity threshold for vector index candidates.
min_vector_similarity.title: Min Vector Similarity

query.description: Natural-language migration question or keywords to search across rules and community insights.
query.title: Query

rrf_k.description: Reciprocal Rank Fusion k constant; higher values smooth rank differences.
rrf_k.title: Rrf K

top_k_per_index.description: Number of candidate IDs to retrieve from each underlying index before fusion.
top_k_per_index.title: Top K Per Index

tools.name: search_migration_knowledge

tools.description:
Search OpenRewrite recipe descriptions using hybrid BM25 + vector ranking (RRF).

        Returns up to max_results recipe hits with statement and score.
        Filters only_composite and require_no_params are applied at the Cypher layer.
        - only_composite: filters on the graph property r.composite (boolean), not r.isComposite.
        - require_no_params: excludes recipes that have (r)-[:HAS_PARAM]->(p:RecipeParam {required: true}).
          Required parameters are modelled as RecipeParam nodes, not as an array property.

max_results.description: Maximum number of fused OpenRewrite recipe hits to return.
max_results.title: Max Results

min_vector_similarity.description: Minimum vector similarity threshold for vector index candidates.
min_vector_similarity.title: Min Vector Similarity

only_composite.description: When true return only composite recipes; when false only non-composite recipes; when null do not filter.
only_composite.title: Only Composite

query.description: Natural-language recipe search query, for example a migration topic or framework feature.
query.title: Query

require_no_params.description: When true, exclude recipes with required RecipeParam nodes.
require_no_params.title: Require No Params

rrf_k.description: Reciprocal Rank Fusion k constant; higher values smooth rank differences.
rrf_k.title: Rrf K

top_k_per_index.description: Number of candidate IDs to retrieve from each underlying recipe index before fusion.
top_k_per_index.title: Top K Per Index

tools.name: search_openrewrite_recipes

tools.description:
Return migration rules and lifecycle alerts for a framework version range.

    Queries all MigrationRule nodes whose version range covers [current_version, target_version].
    Optionally filter by scope ('api-surface', 'runtime', 'config', 'build', 'test') and
    severity ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical').

    Returns: rules list (statement, steps, scopes, recipes), lifecycle_alerts list.
    Each rule contains steps: [] and scopes: [] when no MigrationStep/BreakingScope nodes
    exist in the graph (pre-redesign data) — this is expected, not an error.

    When include_recipes=True, each rule includes a recipes list. Recipes are per step
    (traversal: REQUIRES_STEP → AUTOMATED_BY). Each recipe entry includes step_id identifying
    the MigrationStep that has the AUTOMATED_BY edge.

classification.description: Optional entityClassification filters such as 'actionable', 'incomplete', or 'informational'.
classification.title: Classification

current_version.description: Source framework version to migrate from.
current_version.title: Current Version

format.description: 'json' for structured output or 'markdown' for a concise Markdown summary.
format.title: Format

framework.description: Framework name for the migration range, for example 'Spring Boot'.
framework.title: Framework

include_lifecycle.description: Include lifecycle alerts for versions in the migration range when true.
include_lifecycle.title: Include Lifecycle

include_recipes.description: Include linked OpenRewrite recipe metadata for each migration rule when true.
include_recipes.title: Include Recipes

target_version.description: Target framework version to migrate to.
target_version.title: Target Version

top_n.description: Maximum number of migration rules to return after filtering and ranking.
top_n.title: Top N

user_entities.description: Optional scanned codebase entities: FQCNs, simple class names, group:artifact coordinates, artifact IDs, or property keys.
user_entities.title: User Entities

verbose.description: Request verbose rule output when supported by downstream formatting.
verbose.title: Verbose

tools.description:
Produce a two-track migration plan: auto (scriptable) and manual (human review required).

        Auto track: steps with automatable=true, effort=mechanical, and a linked OpenRewrite recipe.
        Manual track: all other steps. Falls back to rule-level cards when no MigrationStep nodes exist.

        Returns: auto_track list, manual_track list, fallback_to_rule_cards bool.
        An empty auto_track is expected in the first release (no AUTOMATED_BY edges yet).

tools.description:
Check whether a framework version exists in the graph and on Maven Central.

        direction='ceil': resolve to the lowest graph node >= requested version (for target checks).

        Returns: status, exists_in_graph, nodeId, resolved_version, rounded, ahead_of_catalogue,
                 ga_available, latest_patch, hint.
        On Maven Central probe failure, returns status='ok' with ga_available=False and a hint.

tools.description:
Submit a developer-contributed migration insight. Writes a MigrationRule node with ruleType='community_insight'.

    Near-duplicate detection runs a three-pass pipeline (exact → vector → BM25+cosine) with a
    0.92 cosine similarity threshold before write. Returns status='duplicate' if a similar insight
    already exists — no new node is created.

    Return field semantics across all three status paths:
    - status='ok':        insight_id=<new element ID>,  duplicate_of=None
    - status='duplicate': insight_id=None,              duplicate_of=<existing element ID>
    - status='error':     insight_id=None,              duplicate_of=None

    Not idempotent — call once per unique finding.

    Note: the parameter 'spring_boot_version' holds the framework version string
    regardless of the 'framework' value (e.g. '3.2' for Spring Boot, '30' for WildFly).

affected_classes.description: Optional affected fully-qualified class names or simple class names.
affected_classes.title: Affected Classes

affected_dependencies.description: Optional affected dependency coordinates or artifact IDs.
affected_dependencies.title: Affected Dependencies

confidence.description: Optional confidence score for the insight, typically between 0 and 1.
confidence.title: Confidence

evidence_url.description: Optional source URL supporting the submitted insight.
evidence_url.title: Evidence Url

framework.description: Framework name whose Version node should receive the community insight.
framework.title: Framework

solution.description: Optional recommended remediation or workaround text.
solution.title: Solution

spring_boot_version.description: Framework version string to attach the insight to; name is legacy and applies to any framework.
spring_boot_version.title: Spring Boot Version

statement.description: Developer-contributed migration finding or workaround to store as a community insight.
statement.title: Statement

tools.description:
Return deprecation metadata and replacement for a single entity name (one hop only).

    entity_name must be the fully-qualified name as stored in the graph
    (e.g. 'org.springframework.boot.env.EnvironmentPostProcessor', not 'EnvironmentPostProcessor').
    Short or partial names will return status='not_found'.

    Returns: entity_name, entity_type, deprecated_in, removed_in, replaced_by (direct successor only), and related rules.
    For the full replacement chain across multiple versions use entity_evolution instead.
    Returns status='not_found' when the entity is not in the graph.

entity_name.description: Fully-qualified entity name stored in the graph; partial or short names return not_found.
entity_name.title: Entity Name

framework.description: Framework name to search, for example 'Spring Boot'.
framework.title: Framework

tools.name: resolve_deprecation

tools.description:
Trace the full REPLACED_BY replacement chain for an entity, up to 5 hops.

    entity_name must be the fully-qualified name as stored in the graph
    (e.g. 'org.springframework.boot.env.EnvironmentPostProcessor', not 'EnvironmentPostProcessor').

    Returns: chain list where each node includes entity_name, entity_type, deprecated_in,
    removed_in, and related rules. The chain starts at entity_name and follows REPLACED_BY
    edges until the terminus or the 5-hop limit.

entity_name.description: Fully-qualified origin entity name stored in the graph for replacement-chain traversal.
entity_name.title: Entity Name

framework.description: Framework name to search, for example 'Spring Boot'.
framework.title: Framework

tools.name: entity_evolution

tools.description:
Return the authoritative graph schema as a Markdown string. No Cypher is executed.

    Use this before execute_custom_cypher to understand available node labels, relationship
    types, and property names. Returns: schema_markdown string.
tools.name: get_graph_schema

tools.description:
Execute a read-only Cypher query against the graph and return rows.

    Blocked keywords (returns status='blocked'): CREATE, MERGE, SET, DELETE, REMOVE, DROP, CALL db.
    Only SELECT-equivalent MATCH queries are permitted. Returns: rows list, row_count.
    Call get_graph_schema first to verify node labels and property names before writing a query.

query.description: Read-only Cypher query. Mutation/admin keywords such as CREATE, MERGE, SET, DELETE, REMOVE, DROP, and CALL db are blocked.
query.title: Query

tools.name: execute_custom_cypher
